rules: Any post-processor that replaces CSS vars globally MUST re-inject contrast-safe values into white-background sections afterward — global replacement corrupts contrast-fix overrides silently
Generator change (wrapInDocument equivalent) → same-class sweep: does every downstream post-processor still receive what it expects? They have no import — the contract is implicit
Test ALL palette/theme variants after any pipeline change, not just the default — dark palettes expose contrast bugs that light palettes hide
After a style change: accept → save → navigate away → return and confirm the saved version persisted (React state and iframe DOM diverge on remount)
A fix in one post-processor implies checking the parallel post-processor for the same gap — they share code patterns but are edited independently
_comment: Starter for HTML/CSS generation pipelines with a generator stage and one or more post-processors. Rules distilled from the class of bugs where Pass 1 overwrites what Pass N restores.
